completed.summary: Autonomous assurance foundation: Gate 0 provenance, fail-closed assurance schema, deterministic A1 auditor, tests and docs.
No-regression ratchet for measured deterministic A1 defect classes.
Unit 1 repaired to zero deterministic findings, controlled GB/US example audio regenerated, version-bound artifacts refreshed, and strict Unit 1 assurance locked into validate:data.
Versioned four-role semantic judge schemas, fail-closed arbitration, hash/version evidence binding, semantic evidence consistency check and tests.
Curriculum-aware semantic packets, four versioned role prompts, opt-in isolated OpenAI-compatible/local runner, evidence merge command, and packet freshness CI.
Fail-closed external evidence ingestion, stale hash/version rejection, cross-role isolation checks, endpoint preflight, compatibility switch, and tests.
Manual-only semantic judge execution workflow, role-scoped preflight, automatic-trigger/write-permission safety gate, and recorded endpoint-resolution contract.
Verified four-provider zero-cost judge allocation, machine-readable presets, automatic workflow defaults, and CI enforcement of zero-cost-only distinct provider/model policy.
Re-ranked free judges by role fit; upgraded Persian to Gemini 3.8 Flash, pedagogy to MiniMax M2.7 Free, adversarial to Qwen 3.8 27B; retained GPT-OSS 120B for English.
Frozen 28-case Vajefy semantic calibration, pre-registered promotion thresholds, repeated-run stability checks, qualification ledger, and Unit 1 qualification gate.
One-dispatch-per-role calibration automation: three repeats, strict scoring, qualification recording, allowlisted commit, and retained raw evidence.
Automatic main-push exact-revision wait plus GitHub OIDC authenticated GET-only semantic gateway contract smoke; no inference.
